title: Split Open shared definitions
description: Definitions the songs, bands and guide schemas share. The stem list here is the one the player has slots for; scripts/schema.py reads it, so a new stem is added here and in app.js.

stem.description: A player's channel: one of the stems a song can have.

slug.description: An id for a URL hash or a file name: letters, digits, - and _.

text.description: A string with something in it.

clock.description: A moment in the song as m:ss, with tenths if wanted (1:05.5). Kept as a string: in YAML 1.2, which the player reads, 0:30 is text.

gain.description: A fader level, 0 to 1.5 (1 is unity).
